units.source_text: 当我意识到时，我已遍体鳞伤，烧伤的或擦伤的，在流淌着鲜血。

en.t: When I came to my senses, I was already covered with wounds, burns and scrapes, and blood was flowing from them.

units.source_text: 手指也渗出了鲜血，显然是刚才叩门受伤的。

en.t: Blood was also seeping from my fingers, evidently from the wounds I had suffered while pounding on the gate a moment before.

units.source_text: 我像一匹遁逃的野兽，舔了舔自己的伤口。

en.t: Like a wild beast that had fled for its life, I licked my own wounds.
